# Able Tower Sharjah

> Able Tower is a high-rise building in Sharjah, arranged over a basement, ground floor, mezzanine and twenty-two upper storeys, giving twenty-four levels above ground. It stands within the emirate's dense urban core, where towers of this scale supply apartment accommodation for residents of Sharjah and for commuters working across the border in Dubai. Parking and building services occupy the lower levels.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Sharjah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This high-rise tower in Sharjah is arranged over a basement, ground floor, mezzanine and 22 upper floors. It was delivered with Sun Engineering as main contractor and Adnan Saffarini as consultant. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the tower, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services across all levels.
